Package de.hof.dms.service

Class OcrAdminService

java.lang.Object
de.hof.dms.service.OcrAdminService
@Service @Profile("!no-mongo") public class OcrAdminService extends Object
Administrative view over the OCR processing queue. Lists OCR jobs by status and allows re-queuing failed jobs. OCR status values progress pending → processing → completed, or failed on error.
